meta.disclaimer: Sample data are transformed (noise/jitter). Scores demonstrate comparative methodology for mega-event resource readiness — not ground-truth city rankings.

formula.readiness: min-max rescale of inverted stress to 0–100 across 11 hosts; higher = lower relative summer nexus load
formula.play_rule: recommended_plays require match_score>0 (elevated z on target drivers); general_options are non-pressing fallbacks

indicator_source.label: spend-patterns per-shop summer rates (map tables)
indicator_source.unit: energy/water/co2e per trading shop-month; city size does not drive rank

ops_context.grain_note: absolute = provisioning scale (store-visits totals); readiness uses per-shop rates from spend-patterns map tables

ui_slots.export_card: one scorecard object = one printable city playbook page
